message.content:
{
  "refuse": null,
  "language": "en",
  "company": "BeanBox",
  "product": "A specialty coffee subscription service based in Kyiv.",
  "audience": "Seed investors",
  "goal": "Raise 300k EUR to open a second roastery.",
  "tone": "confident",
  "facts_from_buyer": [
    "Specialty coffee subscription",
    "Based in Kyiv",
    "Price: 18 EUR per month",
    "400 paying subscribers",
    "Traction achieved after 6 months",
    "Two founders: a roaster and a growth marketer",
    "Raising 300k EUR",
    "Use of funds: open a second roastery"
  ],
  "must_include": [
    "Team background (roaster and growth marketer)",
    "Current traction (400 subs in 6 months)",
    "Unit economics (18 EUR/month)",
    "Funding amount and specific use of funds (second roastery)"
  ],
  "avoid": [
    "Invented customer testimonials",
    "Fake market size data",
    "Unsubstantiated growth projections"
  ],
  "open_questions": [
    "What is the customer acquisition cost (CAC)?",
    "What is the monthly churn rate?",
    "What is the current Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)?",
    "What is the gross margin per subscription?",
    "Why is a second roastery necessary now (capacity constraint vs. growth)?",
    "What is the competitive landscape in Kyiv?",
    "What is the projected runway with the 300k EUR raise?"
  ]
}
